test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements : **

Some Plates are Bowls. 

Some Bowls are Cups. 

**Conclusions : **

I. Some Plates are Cups. 

II. Some Bowls are Plates.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17c02634408d035072ce57a61925ba6c6ffc4b7ff614e8ef40eece577c294596.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some Plates are Cups. (False)

There is no direct relation between plates and cups so, we cannot define the relation between them. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17c02634408d035072ce57a61925ba6c6ffc4b7ff614e8ef40eece577c294596.png] 

II. Some Bowls are Plates . (True)

As we observed in the above Venn diagram, there is a direct relation between Plates and Bowls.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.
